intervals.label: data taking (runs 1 and 2)
intervals.note: End: 'Run 2 ended in November 2015' (official PICO-2L page); the chamber was idle between the end of run 1 (May 2014) and the start of run 2 (February 2015).

intervals.label: run 1 (3.2-8.1 keV thresholds)
intervals.quote: The first run of PICO-2L lasted from October 2013 to May 2014.

intervals.label: run 2 (3.3 keV threshold)
intervals.note: Start from the same page: 'PICO-2L started a second data taking phase in February of 2015 with a new, all synthetic quartz vessel and a new set of piezoelectric sensors.'
intervals.quote: Run 2 ended in November 2015, and in January 2016 PICO reported the 2L bubble chamber was background free.

placements.note: SNOLAB (hall not asserted; see the experiment record).
placements.quote: The PICO Collaboration (formed from the merger of PICASSO and COUPP) has now operated a 2.90 kg C3 F8 bubble chamber from October 2013 to May 2014 in the SNOLAB underground laboratory in Canada, at 6010 meters of water equivalent depth.

summary.plain: A two-litre jar of superheated C3F8 refrigerant, filmed by cameras and listened to by microphones, deep underground.
summary.technical: Two-litre fused-silica jar (run 2: all-synthetic-quartz vessel) with stainless-steel bellows, stereoscopic cameras and piezoelectric acoustic sensors, in a water shield.

technology.quote: PICO-2L started a second data taking phase in February of 2015 with a new, all synthetic quartz vessel and a new set of piezoelectric sensors.
technology.value: Superheated C3F8 bubble chamber (fused-silica jar, bellows, cameras, piezoelectric acoustic sensors)
